headless.note: Build/runtime surface used by UR-Recomp is command-line or libretro and does not require a desktop session.

purpose: Independent high-accuracy libretro oracle for cross-checking emulator-sensitive behavior. Patched narrowly to expose its 128 KiB work RAM as RETRO_MEMORY_SYSTEM_RAM and the cartridge battery RAM as RETRO_MEMORY_SAVE_RAM so headless harnesses can read guest state and inject an exact SRAM image; no timing or emulation change.
